policy.before_effective: Do not apply a proposed or future event.
policy.on_or_after_effective: Apply only the final implemented terms known before effective date.
policy.date_only_known_at: Prior calendar date is required; same-day without time fails closed.
policy.changed_plan: IS_CHANGED=1 or multiple versions requires independent final implementation evidence and superseded-plan identification; otherwise affected security-date is UNRESOLVED and cannot enter a PIT factor snapshot.
policy.later_correction: Any post-effective correction to event terms or non-common factor normalization invalidates affected historical ratios; do not silently refresh a qualified snapshot.
